newsitem.title: UK: SHELL OPTIMISTIC ABOUT CHEMICALS SECTOR.
newsitem.headline: SHELL OPTIMISTIC ABOUT CHEMICALS SECTOR.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group said on Thursday it was optimistic about its chemicals sector despite a "disappointing" second quarter performance.
Mark Moody-Stuart, chairman of Shell Transport and Trading, said "I am confident that by the end of the year we will be ahead of our original road map targets."
Shell's ongoing restructuring of its chemicals portfolio should help results in the second half of the year, he added.
Chemicals profits fell one percent in the second quarter due to one-off items such as plant start-up costs in Singapore, Moody-Stuart said.
Another negative "blip" was the fact Shell took 70 percent of its plant maintenance costs in the three months to June 30, he added.
"But these are not excuses. we should have taken them in our stride," Moody-Stuart said.
